title: Supplier appeared on the definitive 69-B list after we deducted eight invoices
notes: The headline case. The account is the one we always pay and the amount is ordinary, so nothing about the payment itself looks wrong. What is wrong is fiscal and retroactive, which is why the hook is not the impersonation story.
